assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Six small panels of four lines each, giving N = 0 (four parallel lines), N = 1 (four lines through one point), N = 3 (three parallel lines and a transversal), N = 4 (two pairs of parallel lines), N = 5 (two parallel lines and two lines crossing between them) and N = 6 (general position).

difficulty_rationale: Finding all the configurations is easy, but proving that exactly two intersection points is impossible needs a careful case analysis.
